store_entries.name: assistant.sqlite
store_entries.action: Extract verified per-owner rows into a new database; retain original consistent snapshot.
store_entries.verification: Schema fingerprint, integrity, foreign keys, unambiguous owner joins. This tool does not extract rows.

store_entries.name: assistant.sqlite-wal
store_entries.action: Refuse snapshot with WAL; operator must supply a complete consistent stopped/checkpointed copy.
store_entries.verification: Must be absent, including empty sidecars.

store_entries.name: assistant.sqlite-shm
store_entries.action: Refuse snapshot with SHM; never independently copy live database files.
store_entries.verification: Must be absent, including empty sidecars.

store_entries.name: writer.lock
store_entries.action: Create fresh target writer lock only at target admission; never open/lock source here.
store_entries.verification: Only regular non-symlink files allowed in supplied snapshot.

store_entries.name: provider-secrets.key
store_entries.action: Never copy shared root key into owner volumes. Decrypt only in authorized migration boundary; re-encrypt shared/personal credentials with distinct new keys and original AAD proof.
store_entries.verification: This inventory never opens key contents; cryptographic binding proof remains pending. Failure requires affected owner reauthentication, never silent credential loss.

store_entries.name: web-push-vapid.key
store_entries.action: Keep private signing authority at shared push service; preserve per-owner subscriptions and delivery state.
store_entries.verification: This inventory never opens key contents. Rebinding and live delivery proof remain pending.

store_entries.name: auth-epochs.journal
store_entries.action: Keep old global chain once; pin old installation/sequence/head and authenticate new per-owner genesis through independent receiver.
store_entries.verification: Never slice records into a claimed valid old chain. Chain authentication and receiver approval remain pending.

store_entries.name: knowledge-invalidations.journal
store_entries.action: Commit owner invalidations/deletion state at original checkpoint, authenticate new per-owner genesis.
store_entries.verification: No journal parsing or replay here; original-free recovery drill remains pending.

store_entries.name: destructive-intents.journal
store_entries.action: Retain global deletion evidence once and authenticate owner deletion commitment/new genesis.
store_entries.verification: No journal parsing or replay here; original-free recovery drill remains pending.

store_entries.name: cutover-seal.json
store_entries.action: Preserve original seal/checkpoint reference once; new owner cutover needs authenticated transfer certificate.
store_entries.verification: File presence is inventoried only; seal authentication remains pending.

store_entries.name: cutover-checkpoint
store_entries.action: Refuse snapshot containing transition staging. Resolve using existing cutover recovery before making a stopped copy.

external_boundaries.name: configured-browser-profile-and-recovery-root
external_boundaries.action: Map every browser workspace/profile/recovery capsule to exact tenant/account and original lifetime; reject shared HOME or ambiguous paths.
external_boundaries.verification: External paths are not opened/discovered by this tool; owner manifests, referenced file hashes and recovery proofs are pending.

external_boundaries.name: configured-gws-registry-and-auth-directory
external_boundaries.action: Share only GWS executable; preserve exact personal registry binding and move owner credentials without copying shared auth HOME.
external_boundaries.verification: External registry/key paths and cryptographic binding proof require separate owner-authorized inventory.

external_boundaries.name: configured-claude-auth-root-and-provider-cli-caches
external_boundaries.action: Preserve account/environment/profile/root binding; prove separate conversation/session/cache and token refresh writer before reuse.
external_boundaries.verification: External paths and same-auth concurrent isolation are not inspected here.

external_boundaries.name: encrypted-backups-journal-receivers-and-pins
external_boundaries.action: Keep old global archives once outside personal volumes; authenticate each owner checkpoint/new encrypted backup and persist independent receiver approval.
external_boundaries.verification: No backup keys, receiver trust pins or remote paths are opened; authenticated transition and source-free restore remain pending.

external_boundaries.name: separate-vault-service-and-client-keys
external_boundaries.action: Keep existing ciphertext/client key boundary and owner namespace; retain durable deletion intent centrally until same-event ACK.
external_boundaries.verification: No vault ciphertext/client keys are copied or opened; per-owner restore and ACK-loss drill remain pending.

external_boundaries.name: private-media-and-file-payloads
external_boundaries.action: Current media_objects stores bytes/thumbnail in SQLite; extract by verified owner with original digest/revision; do not infer unrecognized filesystem media paths.
external_boundaries.verification: Source inventory checks ownership only; payload digest/size reconciliation and new target file references remain pending.
